value.definition: one body written at one path that does not have that body already

invariants.statement: A path with no body is written as an addition.
A path with another body is written over as a replace with the whole body each side.
A path already with the body given is left as that path is.
A body already there states no edit rather than a refusal.
A program folding many bodies together lands the bodies that moved.
Nothing here judges whether a body may be written.
Nothing here reads the disk.
A caller states under `old` the body that caller composed its body from.
A path holding a body other than `old` is refused rather than written over.
A caller stating no `old` writes over whatever body is there.
A path already holding the body given is left alone whatever `old` states.

value.definition: one body written at one path, with the entries in that body given their ids

invariants.statement: A path with no body is written as an addition.
A path with another body is written over as a replace with the whole body each side.
A path already with the body given is refused rather than written again.
A line of a file of entries arriving without an `id` is given one here.
A line already stating an `id` keeps that `id`.
Whether a path holds entries is read from the module minting an entry's `id`.
Every caller writing a whole body at a path reaches this change to write it.
An `id` is worked out after the body given is weighed against the body there.
A caller may state the body its own body was composed against.
A body stated that is not the body there refuses the change unwritten.
A caller stating no such body is held to nothing and writes over what is there.
Nothing here judges whether a body may be written.
Nothing here reads the disk.

value.definition: one page moved to another folder with every file that page keeps beside the page

invariants.statement: A move keeps the name the page has.
A path the index files no page at is refused.
A page and every file that page keeps beside the page are moved together.
Which files sit beside a page is read from the index rather than from the folder.
A file the page claims and the tree has no body at is passed over.
A file beside the page lands under its own name in the folder the page lands in.
A file beside the page under a TypeScript name is moved by `move-file-code`.
Every other file beside the page is moved by `move-file`.
A refusal from any change reached here refuses the whole move.
The files beside the page are judged by the guard this change names.
Nothing here changes the data the page states.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

value.definition: one file moved to another path, with nothing else judged

invariants.statement: A move lands as a path moved rather than a body written and a body taken away.
A path with no body is refused rather than moved.
A path a body already stands at is refused rather than written over.
Nothing here rewrites the paths the moved body names.
The calling change repoints every body naming the path that moved.

value.definition: one page taken away with every file that page keeps beside the page

invariants.statement: A path the index files no page at is refused.
A page and every file that page keeps beside the page go together.
A file beside the page goes whether or not git tracks that file.
Which files sit beside a page is read from the index rather than from the folder.
A file the page claims and the tree has no body at is left alone.
The page's entry in the parent's `parts` is dropped before any file goes.
A file importing a second file going in the same act goes before that file.
The files beside the page go before the page's own file.
A file beside the page under a TypeScript name goes by `remove-code-file`.
Every other file beside the page goes by `remove-file`.
The page's own file goes by `remove-code-file`.
A refusal from any change reached here refuses the whole removal.
Every index question here is asked of the world the caller hands in.
Containment is a relation named in the parent's `parts`.
The module taking a value away is called for the parent's `parts` rather than reached.
A parent naming the page bare rather than qualified is dropped just the same.
The relations naming the page are judged by a guard this change names.
The files beside the page are judged by a guard this change names.

value.definition: one file taken away, with nothing else judged

invariants.statement: A path with no body is refused rather than taken away.
Nothing here judges whether a file may go.
The calling change judges whether a file may go.
A directory is left to the landing rather than taken away here.
Nothing here reads the disk or an index.
